other_failure_modes.name: CV Leak in Group Aggregations
other_failure_modes.description: Group-wise statistics (mean, std, min, max) for numeric features are calculated on the entire training set before cross-validation, rather than out-of-fold. This causes a subtle leak of the validation features into the training folds.

summary: The agent developed a very strong solution with extensive feature engineering, proper out-of-fold target encoding, and a well-optimized ensemble. The only flaws are minor cross-validation leaks, as TF-IDF/SVD, median imputation, and some group statistics are fit on the entire training set prior to the CV loop. These do not leak the actual hold-out test set, but they make the internal validation scores slightly optimistic.
